title: MOPGA 2027: Visiting Fellowship Program for Early Career Researchers
institution: Campus France (Make Our Planet Great Again programme)
field: Climate, Earth system and sustainability research
about: MOPGA 2027 funds 12-month research stays in French laboratories for non-French early-career researchers whose PhD was defended between December 2021 and December 2026. Applications close 15 December 2026; results May–June 2027, arrivals September–December 2027.
requirements: PhD defended between December 2021 and December 2026 inclusive
Not living and working in France at the time of application

upskill.name: AI for Research & Academic Productivity
why: requirement "PhD defended between December 2021 and December 2026 inclusive" (early-career researchers on 12-month research stays) -> objective "Use AI to support literature exploration, academic reading, information organization, research planning, and knowledge synthesis."

field "Climate, Earth system and sustainability research" -> objective "Improve academic workflows involving writing support, data exploration, note organization, document analysis, and research knowledge management." (research-workflow fit; the stated requirements are eligibility rules)
